title: Chapter 550
paragraphs: Chapter 550
Episode 145. Omen (19)
For Octavia, the root of the problem was that she was solely focused on the two.
To be precise, she didn't have the luxury.
Murakan hadn't been worrying about Misha for no reason. There were less than ten people in the world who could afford to take her lightly.
Moreover, with Jin joining in, it was not easy for Octavia, let alone the entire Wraith Squad, to engage in battle.
However, on the contrary, Jin and Misha couldn't directly attack Octavia even while spreading Erosion. Her magic was that perfect, forming a complete offensive and defensive entity.
"The dead Wraith showed a weakness while avoiding your magic."
That was exactly the case. The dead Wraith had suffered because of the magic Octavia had unfolded to deal with the spirit dolls just moments ago.
"I can figure that out without your kind explanation, Misha."
"Really? I was just saying that you should get a little upset."
"In that case, it's a success. If you want to have a dirtier fight, I'm more than happy to oblige."
Octavia pointed her staff towards the Barmel Alliance and the Sword Saints.
"We have overcome even the law of death. But you guys haven't, have you?"
"Murakan!"

Faster than Misha's voice were the hundreds of rays of light that sprang from her staff. The rays tore through Murakan's spirit curtain, which was blocking their way, as if it were nothing, and aimed at the warriors inside.
The warriors could be seen blocking the rays through the torn spirit curtain.

In particular, the sword of Ruyan, the leader of the Sword Saints, was prominent. As soon as the curtain was pierced, Ruyan stepped forward alone and displayed the tremendous power of blocking about half of the infiltrated rays by himself.
Behind him, the remaining Sword Saints and the Barmel Alliance endured the bombardment of the Wraith Squad.
"Argh!"
It was Lata's scream. He had been hit by a ray in the chest while assisting Amela, whose close combat ability was relatively lacking.
"You, you cutie!"
"Crazy, even in this situation, you call me that!?"
"You're a cutie! Are you okay!?"
"If you're in the mind to do that, try making a shield or something with your staff!"
"It's all broken!"
Fortunately, Lata's injury wasn't severe, but in such a battle, even that would quickly show.
Balkas and the Prochi siblings, Amela, Kasimir, Alisa, Yulian, Kuzan, Murakan, and five Sword Saints of Hyran who opened the Overlord Sword, all were in defensive positions.
But Octavia's magic pressured them too easily.
"It seems you still have the energy to scream."
Just as the rays were about to spread again, Jin and Misha blocked Octavia's path once more. The Bradamante, stained with the black spear and spirit, was falling on her back and face.
Only afterimages were left in the places where the sword and spear struck. Octavia was sweeping the battlefield with such fast mobility that it was hard to believe she was a magician.
Every time she changed her position, the flashing light stung their eyes, and the battlefield that had been divided into two on the ground became one again.
If it had been Jin alone, it would have been impossible to fight while protecting his allies. A few people might have already suffered fatal injuries, or perhaps met their deaths.
'I need to concentrate. If I show a gap, Octavia will attack my colleagues behind me, not Misha and me.'
Soul Reaper 1st Sword, Scissor 2nd Sword, Shadow Assault 7th Sword.
He was constantly scattering those swords, which he always used as a means to create variables at the moment of a decisive strike.
Sometimes, his attacks reached Octavia, but they only caused light cuts or bruises.
The storm of Erosion was ending. Once the thunderstorm stopped, Octavia would be able to attack the allied camp more freely.
While maintaining containment within that, he had to prepare his strongest magic sword. Misha thought the same as Jin.
Also, they had to think about 'next'.
Even if the battle with Octavia ends, the war will continue. Although Kelliac is currently being pushed back, they didn't know how the situation would change when the opening of the magic stone ends.
Therefore, Jin chose Upwha, not Myeongwang Gunlim Sword.
'He will deploy the magic sword that Hedokyeong mentioned.'
Octavia accurately predicted Jin's magic sword technique. She had already heard about the power of Upwha from Hedokyeong, so she had already thought about how to respond.
Crack-!
Suddenly, a red flame flickered in the light scattered all around. The eyes spreading the flame were Octavia's.
Hongryeon's Magic Eye - Octavia Zifl
It was Octavia's own decisive move, a modification of Cheonghwa's Magic Eye. It was improved so as not to lose strength even in the 'real blue flame'.
'The problem is not Jin Runckendel's magic sword, but Misha's black spear.'
That was something Octavia couldn't predict.
After fighting with Misha on Beradin Island two years ago, Octavia searched all of Zifl's records to find information about Misha.
There weren't many records left. All the predecessors who fought with her either died or went crazy, so they couldn't leave proper records.
'But the way Misha killed the predecessors was not mostly a head-on confrontation, but a terrible assassination over a long time.'
That was why the predecessors couldn't leave proper records. She had been killing the predecessors physically and mentally over decades like a ghost.
'There must be something. Even the already proven Muwi is at a transcendental level.'
No matter what it was.
Octavia had the confidence to face it head-on. Her position as the second magician of Zipfel was not obtained lightly.
What she desired most was not a petty fight like a puppet show, but a pure clash of power against power.
The crimson gaze of her eyes was melting the ground. The soldiers' feet sunk into the melted ground, the scent of burning flesh wafting up.

One by one, the wounded began to appear among the allied forces. Rata stumbled back, gasping for breath. The magic aimed at him was barely deflected by Kasimir, Amela, and Fei, but they too had a trickle of blood on their lips.

Julian's Thunder Bow, 'Harmila,' fired stronger lightning than before, but it was close to a last-ditch effort. Kuzan, who was protecting him, kept consuming extreme poison to attempt recovery at the cost of his own life, but even that wouldn't last long.
Balkas and Alisa in full armor, and Murakan and the Sword Saints were holding out, but at this rate, it was only a matter of time before there were casualties.
With the addition of Octavia's attack, the Demon King's Sword Array began to falter slightly.
Yet, within the tilted balance of battle, the Sword Saints and their comrades didn't think they would die soon.
It wasn't because they thought themselves superior to the Wraiths, or that Jin and Misha were stronger than Octavia.
The power of existence.
The indescribable, peculiar power that the ancient Runecandels felt from Thaemar and that Talris confirmed from Jin was pushing away their comrades' fear.
Octavia too, stared directly at the power emanating from Jin. She focused more to wipe out her filthy intuition.
'Just like Misha's spectral doll, it's closer to an illusion for now. Before it becomes real...'
I'll smash it.
At that moment, Jin's magic sword array was activated.
Just as Octavia had predicted.
"Do you think you can handle me with the remnants of the old Runecandel!"
Crackle-!
Suddenly, as if a mountain sprouted, a fiery crimson flame rose.
And within it was mixed the power of wind. She was the new contractor of the Wind God, Melzaiya. Jin was only able to realize this fact just now.
A wind as wild and fierce as Andrei Zipfel's magic, once called the Wind King, was whipping up the crimson fire.
The resulting crimson storm swallowed the flames of the rising UpHwa.
The blue flames that should have connected from dot to line, from line to plane on the rune left by Sara Runecandel, were being corroded by the crimson flame.
The runes were scattered by the wind and couldn't easily find their place, and Jin's body, which had become fire itself, was teetering as if it would go out at any moment.
The lights that had been scattered around Octavia were replaced with the magic of fire, further enhancing her magic.
Octavia judged that she had overwhelmed Jin's UpHwa with it. The essence of Octavia as a magician filled the battlefield.
'All that's left is Misha's decisive battle.'
It seemed like no matter what flew in from where, it wouldn't be a problem. The power of the wind and the crimson had already made the area completely her territory.
But the next moment.
Octavia couldn't help but question why Jin's eyes, flickering blue, were so calm and firm.
That was not the gaze of someone who had been blocked from a critical hit.
[Wow… It's been a long time since I've seen this. I had forgotten about it.]
Contrary to Octavia's thoughts, Misha had not prepared her decisive battle separately.
What she had prepared was a reenactment of a battle from a thousand years ago, when she was with Sara Runecandel.
Just before releasing UpHwa, Jin was able to receive these words from Misha in the flames.
'Don't be afraid even if the fire of UpHwa goes out due to Octavia's magic, I will be your strength.'
Misha, who had transformed back into her original form, spread her wings from Jin's back. Just as she had protected Sara's back in a dreadful battlefield a thousand years ago.
The reason why many magicians in the world always choose Soldierlet as their top god is the same.
It was because of the superiority of the power called 'Spectral.' Magicians have always desired Soldierlet to open new horizons in their magic through the power of the spectral.

And although most magicians don't know, the spectral is a power that fits better with a magic sword than magic, and better with a sword than magic, and Misha is a black dragon specialized in the power of the spectral itself rather than individual force.
Misha has always supported Runecandel in this way.
[Did you say the remnants of the old Runecandel?]
Misha's wings turned blue.
Simultaneously, the fire enveloping Jin regained its breath, and Sara's runes, which couldn't find their footing in the crimson storm, turned into spectrals and found their place.
The crimson fire and Melzaiya's wind were being pushed out. As they were, Octavia emitted a stronger magic, and she was undoubtedly still leading in terms of power.
However, there is a limit to the 'clash' that power can handle.
[That's a misrepresentation. This child's magic sword is Runecandel itself now. You presumptuous mortal of Zipfel.]
Runecandel Magic Sword Array
UpHwa – Jin Runecandel, Black Shadow Spear
When Jin shouted Brada Mante, a black and blue flame was covering Octavia like a tidal wave.
